purpose: Collect a venue reviewer's identity, basis of authority, knowledge basis, exact review subject and one chosen release scope. A completed copy is a review intake record, not release approval.

previousReviewContext.limitation: The existing operator records support the phase-1 sampling history. They do not choose a release scope, classify every node in that scope or confer release authority.

partitionRules: includedNodeIds and excludedNodeIds must each contain unique node ids.
includedNodeIds and excludedNodeIds must be disjoint.
Their union must equal canonicalFrozenReleaseNodeInventory.nodeIds exactly and contain 149 nodes.
missingNodeIds and unexpectedNodeIds must both be empty before allReleaseNodesPartitioned can be true.
Engineering must recompute the counts, intersection and union from the cited frozen inventory.

completionRules: Make a dated copy of this template; do not edit the template file.
Complete every reviewer field and bind the exact record that establishes the reviewer's venue authority by record ref and sha256.
Bind the review and chosen scope to the one canonicalFrozenReleaseNodeInventory object by record reference, sha256, observed count and exact node-id list; no second inventory identity is permitted.

For a bounded release, make includedNodeIds and excludedNodeIds a disjoint and exhaustive partition of that exact frozen inventory and set allReleaseNodesPartitioned only after engineering recomputes the partition evidence.
Classify every node in the chosen scope and list every excluded adjacent area.
Record limitations and any lineage caveat the reviewer accepted.
Bind the exact review completion record by completionRecordRef and completionRecordSha256.
Keep authority none until a separate T-486 review accepts complete evidence.
